slot_scores.name: max_shifts_per_week
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any additional constraints or requirements for the scheduling plan, such as limits on the number of days a student can work, minimum or maximum total hours per week beyond the stated minimums, or restrictions on which students can work on specific days?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly named 'limits on the number of days a student can work,' which directly targets the per-student weekly shift/day cap (H1), and later confirmed its meaning in turn 7.

slot_scores.name: max_students_per_day
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Does the constraint that no more than 3 different students can be scheduled for duty on any single day mean that at most 3 students can have non-zero hours on that day, or does it refer to the number of students working at any specific time slot?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent's turn 6 catch-all did not target a per-day count cap (only 'restrictions on which students can work on specific days'); the daily distinct-student limit was volunteered by the user, and the agent only engaged with it afterward in a clarification. It touched the issue but did not proactively probe it.

slot_scores.name: objective_minimize_gross_pay
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective of the scheduling plan to minimize the total weekly labor cost, or is there another primary goal such as maximizing fairness or minimizing the number of students used?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the optimization objective, offering minimize-total-weekly-labor-cost as an option, which matches H3.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective (H3) was explicitly confirmed in turn 4, and both P1 constraints (H1, H2) were obtained and clarified before READY_TO_MODEL, then incorporated into the model. Although H2 was elicited by user volunteering rather than a targeted probe, its fact was resolved and included, so no P0/P1 hidden slot remained unaddressed at stopping.

summary: The agent explicitly confirmed the objective (H3) and used a catch-all probe that named the weekly working-days cap (H1) and elicited both extra constraints, then clarified each before modeling. H2 was recovered mainly through user volunteering plus a follow-up clarification rather than a proactive targeted question, but overall the interaction resolved all core hidden slots.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
